recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-46495 unless the work group later decides to further refine subscription-management terminology or conformance rules.
issue_request: FHIR-46495 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core change request to synchronize R6 subscription documentation with Backport IG work by describing in-band/client-managed and out-of-band/server-managed subscription styles, including workflow, conformance, management/error responsibilities, and Subscription resource wording that does not assume only subscriber-created subscriptions.
initial_application: Git commit d51aae543ee91023d3a373ffba704fee0904f8c0 explicitly applied FHIR-46495 by updating source/subscriptions.html, source/subscription/subscription-introduction.xml, source/subscription/subscription-notes.xml, the Subscription example, and the Subscription structure definition. That commit is already contained in the current worker branch, master, and the combined branch.
additional_context: FHIR-43505 and FHIR-43514 are Backport IG decisions that FHIR-46495 asked to carry into R6. FHIR-I minutes from 2024-08-05 record the naming decision to use In-band Subscription Management and Out-of-band Subscription Management, while confirming that Subscriptions still exist even if a client cannot directly edit or see them. No conflicting Zulip or Confluence discussion was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/subscriptions.html defines both workflow styles, includes separate creation workflows, splits conformance requirements, and explains out-of-band management/error responsibilities. Current Subscription resource narrative no longer depends on subscriber-only creation and links detailed management/error guidance back to the framework page.

related_jiras.note: Backport IG request to describe dynamic/administrative subscription creation; FHIR-46495 synchronized this idea into R6 using in-band/out-of-band terminology.
Backport IG conformance clarification that server-managed/out-of-band subscriptions relax SubscriptionTopic discovery requirements, cited by FHIR-46495 for R6 conformance text.
